app.title: Recoding Medicine Matchmaker
app.tagline: A directory of European health-data holders and AI teams forming joint applications for the SPRIND Recoding Medicine challenge.
nav.label: Main navigation
footer.sprind: Recoding Medicine is a challenge by SPRIND, the German Federal Agency for Breakthrough Innovation, funded by the Federal Ministry of Health.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: A server error interrupted this page. It is not a sign-out — your session is untouched. Try again, or head back to the directory.
notfound.title: Not found
notfound.body: This page does not exist, or the entry behind it has been removed.
landing.headline: An AI team without a dataset cannot apply. Find the partner that makes you eligible.
landing.subhead: Demonstrable access to at least one suitable health dataset is a hard prerequisite of the Recoding Medicine challenge. This directory pairs European data holders with AI teams so that joint applications exist by 16 October 2026.
landing.fact_stages: Up to 12 teams enter Stage 1 (12 months), up to 7 continue to Stage 2, up to 4 to Stage 3 (6 months each). Pitch Day is early November 2026.
landing.fact_funding: Up to €480k / €455k / €550k per team per stage, as pre-commercial procurement.
landing.fact_hq: The applicant's HQ must be in the EU, EFTA, the UK, or Israel. Individual team members or collaboration partners may sit outside that region.
landing.fact_dataset: Demonstrable access to at least one suitable dataset is a prerequisite. Applications with no dataset component are not accepted.
landing.fact_funding_rule: The work may not be funded in parallel by other public sources.
directory.title: Directory
directory.empty: No entries match these filters. Remove a filter to widen the list.
intro.explainer: Write a short message (up to 500 characters). The recipient sees your public profile and this message. Contact details are exchanged only if they accept.
intro.message_placeholder: Who you are, what you propose, and why this pairing could apply jointly.
intro.sent: Your introduction request to {name} has been sent. You will see their answer in your inbox.
intro.not_open: This organisation is not accepting introduction requests.
intro.signin_first: To request an introduction, sign in or add your profile first.
intro.error_generic: The request was not sent. Try again.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.explainer: Enter the contact email on your profile.
signin.email_sent: If a profile uses this email, a sign-in link has been sent.
claim.title: Access your profile
claim.explainer: This link signs you in to manage your profile. It works once and expires 24 hours after it was issued.
claim.error_generic: This link did not work. Request a new one from the sign-in page.
register.title: Add your profile
register.explainer: List your organisation so potential partners can find you. Fields marked private are never shown publicly — they are exchanged only through accepted introductions. You can edit everything later.
me.title: Your profile
me.delete_body: This permanently removes your organisation profile, match cache, introduction messages, and sign-in tokens from this directory. It cannot be undone. Hiding the profile (visibility) is enough if you only want to leave the public list.
me.delete_email_alt: Prefer not to use the button? Email a deletion request from your profile contact address to
me.delete_confirm_prompt: Type the organisation name exactly to confirm: {name}
me.delete_error: Deletion failed. Try again, or email the privacy contact.
landing.deleted: Your profile has been permanently deleted from this directory.
outcome.question: Did this directory lead to a joint application?
matches.title: Your matches
matches.explainer: Ranked by a deterministic score out of 100. Every entry shows how the score was earned and what stands in the way — including governance friction that would block an application.
matches.empty_title: No matches above the threshold (35) yet.
matches.empty_nudge.parallel_public_fund: Your profile states the work is funded in parallel by other public sources. That makes any application ineligible, so no matches are generated. Correct the field if this is not the case.
matches.empty_nudge.application_status: Your application status excludes you from matching. Set it to "Intends to apply" or "Applying with a partner" to generate matches.
matches.empty_nudge.open_to_intros: Your profile is closed to introductions. Open it to appear in matching.
matches.empty_nudge.privacy_capability: Fill in your privacy capability (TRE, federated learning, etc.). Access-model compatibility carries 18 of 100 points, and unstated capability blocks locked datasets.
matches.empty_nudge.data_needs: State the data modalities you need. Modality overlap carries 22 of 100 points and cannot be scored while your data needs are empty.
matches.empty_nudge.access_model: One of your datasets has an undecided access model. Deciding it (even provisionally) is the single field that unlocks the most matches.
matches.empty_nudge.languages: Add your working languages. Shared language carries 5 points and is often the tie-breaker above the threshold.
matches.empty_nudge.attending: Mark which events you attend. Co-location carries 4 points and is often the difference at the threshold.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.explainer: Introduction requests you have received and sent. Contact details are revealed to both sides at once when a request is accepted — never before.
inbox.empty: No introduction requests yet. Request one from your matches or any directory profile.
admin.title: Reporting
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.collected_body:
Organisation profiles as entered by their owners: organisation details, dataset descriptions (not the datasets themselves), AI capability, and one contact person (name, email, role).

Introduction messages (up to 500 characters) and accept/decline decisions.

Optional self-reported joint-application outcomes (for aggregate reporting).

A technical event log of profile edits and introduction state changes (security, abuse prevention, service metrics).

We do not collect passwords, payment data, advertising identifiers, precise location, or any patient-level health records.
privacy.purpose_body: To help health-data holders and AI teams find each other and form joint applications to the SPRIND Recoding Medicine challenge (deadline 16 October 2026), including sign-in, directory listing, deterministic matching, and double opt-in introductions.
privacy.visibility_body:
Public directory listings show organisation and capability information needed for partner discovery. Contact details and private dataset governance notes are never shown publicly.

Contact details are exchanged only when both sides of an introduction accept. You can hide your profile or close introductions at any time in your settings.
privacy.retention_body:
Profiles remain until you hide them, delete them in Your profile (/me), or request deletion by email. Profiles and introduction records are deleted no later than 16 October 2027 (twelve months after the application deadline), unless you ask for earlier deletion.

Magic-link tokens are single-use and expire after 24 hours. Aggregate metrics that contain no personal data may be retained in reports.
privacy.deletion_body:
Signed-in users can permanently delete their own profile from Your profile (/me). That action removes the profile, match cache, introductions, and magic-link tokens immediately, and anonymises related event-log entries.

You can also email {email} from the contact address on your profile and name the organisation profile concerned. We will respond without undue delay and within one month where required by law.
form.section_needs: What data does the team need?
form.kind_hint: Pick what you are today. Data holder: you bring datasets. AI team: you bring methods. Consortium: you already have both on one team (and may still be seeking a missing piece). This directory does not merge two existing profiles into a joint SPRIND application — that happens on the challenge site after you introduce.
form.country_hint: The country of your headquarters. Eligibility (EU, EFTA, UK, Israel) is derived from this — it cannot be self-asserted.
form.one_liner_hint: Shown in the directory listing. At most 140 characters.
form.parallel_funding_hint: Work funded in parallel by other public sources is not eligible for this challenge.
form.privacy_capability_hint: The most consequential field in matching. Whether you can work inside a secure processing environment or federate decides which datasets are open to you.
form.datasets_hint: Describe each dataset you can bring to a joint application. Datasets marked as not publicly describable are used for matching but never shown publicly.
form.access_model_hint: How partners could access this data. If undecided, say so — it is matched more cautiously.
form.publicly_describable_hint: If unchecked, this dataset is matched on but its details are hidden from the public directory.
form.contact_privacy_note: Never shown publicly. Exchanged only when both sides of an introduction accept.
form.track_record_hint: Optional. Up to five links, one per line — papers, code repos, deployed products. Each line must be a full URL (https://…). Titles alone won't work.
form.datasets_required_summary: Required per dataset: name, at least one modality, at least one disease area. Everything else has defaults you can adjust.
form.dataset_required_hint: Three fields are required to list a dataset. The rest can stay at defaults until you know more.
form.dataset_optional_hint: Defaults are fine for a first draft — refine scale, access, and governance when you can.
form.validation.title: Fix these before submitting
form.validation.website_invalid: Website must be a full link (e.g. https://your-org.eu).
form.validation.track_record_invalid: Track record: these lines are not valid links — {lines}. Use https://… URLs only, or delete the line.
form.validation.datasets_required: Add at least one dataset with a name, modality, and disease area.
form.validation.dataset_modality: Dataset {n}: pick at least one modality.
form.validation.dataset_disease: Dataset {n}: pick at least one disease area.
form.still_seeking_hint: A consortium is listed for matching only while it is still seeking something (for example a clinical partner). Leave this empty if the team is complete — you stay in the directory, but you will not be shortlisted.
form.error_generic: The profile was not saved. Fix the listed fields and resubmit.
form.created_title: Your profile is in the directory.
form.created_body: You are signed in on this device. Matches are computed already — view them now.
matches.rationale_gap: The main gap is {c} ({earned} of {weight} points).
matches.rationale_no_gap: No significant gaps across the scored factors.
form.prefill_hint: Paste a paragraph about your organisation (or your website's about text). A draft is proposed for you to review — nothing is published until you check every field and submit.
form.prefill_placeholder: We are a university hospital holding a longitudinal oncology imaging cohort of 40,000 patients…
form.prefill_error: Pre-fill is unavailable right now. Fill in the form directly.
form.prefill_applied: Draft applied — highlighted fields still need you. Review every field before submitting.
form.partner_only_hint: Use this if your HQ is outside EU/EFTA/UK/Israel but you want to collaborate with a European-led application.
signin.explainer_email: Enter the contact email on your profile. If it matches, we email a single-use sign-in link valid for 24 hours.
signin.explainer_on_screen: Enter the contact email on your profile. This deployment shows the sign-in link on screen (no email server configured). The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
signin.explainer_server_log: Enter the contact email on your profile. If it matches, a sign-in link is issued for the operators to deliver — it is not shown here.
signin.copy_link_note: If no profile uses that email, this link will not work. Real links work once and expire in 24 hours.
signin.rate_limited: Too many sign-in requests. Try again in a few minutes.
signin.error_generic: Could not start sign-in. Try again.
form.visibility_hint: Public: anyone. Authenticated only: signed-in users. Hidden: not listed (still matchable for intros you already started).
register.explainer_remmy: List your organisation so partners can find you. Chat with Remmy to draft a profile, or fill in the form yourself. Either way, you review every field before anything is published. Private fields are never shown publicly.
remmy.name: Remmy
remmy.hello_create: I am Remmy. Paste your organisation’s About page, or answer one short question at a time — I never publish without your confirmation. Are you a data holder, an AI team, or a consortium?
remmy.hello_update: I am Remmy. Tell me what should change on your profile. I will prepare a draft of the updates for you to verify — nothing is saved until you confirm and click Save.
remmy.error: Remmy could not respond just now. Try again, or switch to the form.
remmy.input_placeholder: Paste an About page, or answer Remmy’s question…
remmy.hint_verify: When ready, click Fill form from chat — your answers transfer over. Highlighted fields still need you.
remmy.path_chat_body: Describe what you do. Remmy asks clarifying questions, then shows a draft for you to confirm — field by field — before the form is filled.
remmy.path_form_body: The traditional profile form. You can still paste text to pre-fill when an LLM is available.
remmy.review_title: Does this match what you meant?
remmy.review_body_create: Remmy prepared this draft from your chat. Confirm only if every point is correct. Nothing is published until you submit the form afterward.
remmy.review_body_update: Remmy prepared these updates from your chat. Confirm only if every change is correct. Nothing is saved until you click Save on the form.
remmy.revise_prompt: That draft is not quite right. Please revise based on what I already told you, and ask if anything is unclear.
remmy.discarded: Draft discarded. Tell me what to change, or start again.
remmy.applied_to_form: Draft applied below. Highlighted fields still need you — especially contact email — then submit when ready.
remmy.applied_to_form_update: Updates applied to the form below. Review the changes, then Save when ready.
remmy.me_teaser: Update your profile by chatting with Remmy — you still confirm every change before Save. For matches and introductions, open Your matches.
guide.title: Ask Remmy
guide.hello: I am Remmy. I can show your top matches, explain why someone fits, draft an introduction for you to send, or name the profile field that would unlock more partners. What do you need?
guide.page_explainer: Chat with Remmy to explore your shortlist and request introductions. Scores always come from the deterministic matcher — Remmy only presents them.
guide.input_placeholder: Ask for matches, an introduction draft, or how to improve your shortlist…
guide.error: Remmy could not respond just now. Try again, or open the classic match list.
guide.suggest_improve: How do I improve my matches?
guide.shortlist_empty: Ask Remmy how to improve your profile, or edit the field named below.
guide.open_sheet: Tap for score breakdown and introduction
guide.intro_body: Edit Remmy’s draft if you like. Contact details are exchanged only if they accept. Remmy never sends this for you.
guide.intro_prompt: Here is a draft introduction to {name}. Edit it, then send when ready.
guide.default_intro: Hello — we would like to explore a joint Recoding Medicine application with {name}. Your directory profile looks like a strong fit. Are you open to an introduction?
guide.gaps_meta: Your profile is {pct}% complete · {count} matches above the threshold right now.
form.gaps_body: The draft left these empty (Remmy never invents contact details). Click a field to jump there.
form.gaps_datasets_nudge: Dataset details are incomplete — fill modality, scale, and access model before submitting.
remmy.paste_ready: Thanks — I read that. Review the draft below, then confirm to fill the form.
remmy.fill_failed: Could not build a draft from this chat. Keep answering, or open a blank form.
footer.directory_body: A matchmaking directory for European health-data holders and AI teams forming joint applications to Recoding Medicine. Contact details stay private until both sides accept an introduction.
privacy.intro: This notice explains how the Recoding Medicine Matchmaker processes personal data. It covers this directory and matchmaking service only — not SPRIND’s challenge application process.
privacy.who_body:
Foresight Institute operates this Matchmaker directory (controller for processing described here). Website: https://foresight.org.

SPRIND (SprinD GmbH) organises the Recoding Medicine challenge. Challenge eligibility, funding, and application questions are SPRIND’s responsibility — contact challenge@sprind.org for those.
privacy.legal_basis_body:
Consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)) when you register and maintain a profile.

Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) in operating a secure, auditable matchmaking service — including rate limits, security logs, and abuse prevention — balanced against your rights as an organisation contact.

You may withdraw consent by deleting your profile in Your profile (/me), or by emailing the privacy contact below.
privacy.recipients_body:
Hosting and delivery of this web application may involve infrastructure providers (for example Vercel) that process request and security logs under their terms.

If email delivery is configured, magic-link messages are sent through the operator’s SMTP provider.

We do not sell personal data. We do not use third-party advertising trackers or marketing analytics pixels.
privacy.ai_body:
If you use Remmy (chat onboarding) or paste-to-prefill, the text you provide is sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible inference gateway to draft profile fields. Drafts are never published or saved until you explicitly confirm and submit the form.

Match scores and blockers are produced by a deterministic rules engine — not by an LLM. AI features are optional; the traditional form always works without them.
privacy.cookies_body: Only strictly necessary cookies: a signed session cookie after you sign in, a locale preference, and an operator admin cookie when applicable. No non-essential cookies, no fingerprinting for advertising, no third-party trackers.
privacy.rights_body:
Under the GDPR you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, or portability of your personal data, and you may object to processing based on legitimate interests.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy.complaint_body: You may complain to your local data-protection authority. In Germany, that is the Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (BfDI): https://www.bfdi.bund.de. A directory of EU authorities is published by the European Data Protection Board: https://edpb.europa.eu.
